The C-only model scores **about 3–4 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1** on MuSiQue-Ans. The exact numbers depend on the split.

- **Validation set (Table 4):** 3.4 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1 (page 11). By comparison, it gets 18.4 | 67.6 on HotpotQA-20K and 50.1 | 92.0 on 2WikiMultihopQA-20K (page 11).
- **Test set (Table 5):** 3.7 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1 (page 11). Table 5 reports test numbers, and all other results are on the validation set (page 10).
- **On MuSiQue-Full (Table 5):** 1.6 An+Sf and 1.1 Sp+Sf (page 11).

The authors say support identification on HotpotQA and 2WikiMultihopQA "can be done to a surprisingly high degree (67.6 and 92.0 F1) even without the question (C-only model), but fails on MuSiQue-Ans" (page 11).

The low scores depend on how the dataset was built (pages 11–12):
- Without the Disconnection Filter, C-only rises to 8.6 | 22.4.
- Without the reduced train-test leakage split, it rises to 69.5 | 42.3.
- With distractors drawn from full Wikipedia instead of positive distractors, it gets 12.5 | 77.7 with 10 paragraphs and 12.4 | 66.4 with 20 paragraphs.
